deltas.unique_value: Exact workpackage mapping, optional-witness integration shape, three-mode ablation framing and source/dependency observations.

Explicit plaintext-TLS sensitivity, secret/prompt capture-off-by-default fence, immutable typed F2 causal-ID join requirement, no-second-truth/no-effect-authority fences, and process/file-only cheapest discriminator.

fusion.canonical_interpretation: AgentSight is an optional external read-only witness/characterization donor, not a canonical state store, effect authority, completion authority or mandatory F2 runtime dependency.
fusion.preferred_next_test: Exact-bound three-mode witness ablation: F2-native telemetry only vs AgentSight non-privileged session/report mode vs privileged eBPF mode, with a lower-risk process/file-only eBPF subcase that leaves TLS plaintext capture disabled unless separately justified.
fusion.privacy_fence: TLS plaintext and prompt/response capture must remain disabled by default for F2 ablation; enable only when a specific discriminator requires it and the active authority admits that sensitive capture surface.
fusion.causal_fence: No AgentSight observation is accepted as F2 causal/effect evidence unless it is joined to explicit immutable F2 run/session/task/effect identity; correlation by time/process alone is insufficient.

supersession.reason: Both append-only deltas contain unique evidence-bearing details. Reconciliation prevents double-counting while preserving provenance.

next_exact_action: Design or execute, only on an admitted surface, the three-mode AgentSight witness ablation and measure incremental event coverage, false positives/misattribution, causal-ID join completeness, CPU/RSS/I/O/latency overhead and whether the core benefit survives with TLS payload capture disabled.
